label: McTaggart's bundle on change does not hold: it is not the case both that no event…, by Reductio
meaning: Suppose McTaggart's bundle. Its first commitment supplies someone who judges or perceives that p; opining is a being moved in the respect of that opinion, so the opiner is moved; whatever is moved changes; all change is A-series change, so some event changes in its A-series determinations; this contradicts the bundle's denial of A-series change.
